pain_points.description: The /courses page shows 'Course catalog is available after sign-in' with zero courses visible. Prospective students cannot evaluate course quality before committing to registration.
pain_points.impact: MASSIVE conversion killer. Users evaluating competitors can browse courses freely. We force registration blind.
pain_points.fix: Show a public course catalog with course cards (title, description, lesson count, difficulty, XP), category filtering, and 'Sign up to start' CTAs.

pain_points.description: The /labs page shows 'Lab catalog is available after sign-in' with zero labs visible. The platform's biggest differentiator (540 hands-on labs) is completely invisible to prospects.
pain_points.impact: Users cannot evaluate the lab experience before signing up. Homepage mentions '540 hands-on labs' but clicking Labs shows nothing.
pain_points.fix: Show a public lab catalog with lab cards (title, domain, difficulty, estimated time), domain filtering, and 'Sign up to access' CTAs.

pain_points.description: Breadcrumb shows raw UUID '76cc73c5 c198 4392 affa 37d2fb7be2a9' instead of the lab name.
pain_points.impact: Users have no idea what lab they're looking at. Confusing and unprofessional.
pain_points.fix: Breadcrumb should show the lab's actual name from the API response instead of the UUID.

pain_points.description: After clicking a lab, the page shows only 'Loading lab...' spinner with no lab info, title, description, or objectives.
pain_points.impact: Users don't know if the page is broken or just slow. No fallback content.
pain_points.fix: Show lab metadata immediately from page props. Only show spinner for terminal/workspace area, not the entire page.

pain_points.description: Sidebar has 20+ links but no clear 'Start Here' or 'Getting Started' path for new users.
pain_points.impact: Choice paralysis. Users don't know whether to start with Courses, Labs, Learning Paths, or something else.
pain_points.fix: Add prominent 'Start Here' section at top of sidebar for users with <100 XP.

pain_points.description: Courses page shows 20 courses in flat grid with no recommendation. Every course says 'Begin training' with no guidance.
pain_points.impact: Users don't know which course to start with. May pick advanced course first and get frustrated.
pain_points.fix: Add 'Recommended for You' section at top. Show 'Continue Where You Left Off' for returning users.

pain_points.description: Persistent 'Learner View active' banner takes ~80px on every page. Shows 'Open Admin Workspace' button to all users.
pain_points.impact: Wasted screen real estate. Confusing for non-admin users.
pain_points.fix: Show banner once on first login, then dismiss. Or make it a subtle header indicator.

pain_points.description: Global search bar says 'Search course catalog...' but only searches courses on Enter. Labs, assessments, certifications not searchable.
pain_points.impact: Users expect global search but get course-only filtering. Labs are not searchable from global search.
pain_points.fix: Make it a true global search (Cmd+K palette) or rename to 'Filter courses...'

pain_points.description: Entire sidebar hidden behind hamburger menu on mobile. Users may not realize more content exists.
pain_points.impact: Mobile users may think dashboard homepage IS the entire platform.
pain_points.fix: Add bottom tab bar on mobile for top 4-5 actions (Home, Courses, Labs, Community, Profile).

pain_points.description: Community page shows 'No activity yet' and 'No leaderboard data' with no guidance.
pain_points.impact: Community features feel abandoned. New users don't know how to generate activity.
pain_points.fix: Show sample activity or 'Be the first to post' CTA. Add 'Join a Team' prompt.

pain_points.description: All certification tiers show 'Requirements pending' with requirements listed but no 'Start Working Toward This' button.
pain_points.impact: Users see what they need but don't know how to get there.
pain_points.fix: Add 'Start Path' button linking to relevant courses/labs for that certification tier.

pain_points.description: Leaderboard appears in both 'Compete' AND 'Community' sections of sidebar.
pain_points.impact: Navigation confusion. Users don't know which to click.

pain_points.description: Public pages have no footer with Terms, Privacy, About, Contact links.
pain_points.impact: Users cannot find legal pages or contact info from homepage.
pain_points.fix: Add proper footer with Terms, Privacy, About, Contact, social links.

pain_points.description: 'Choose Your Path' looks like text label, not a clickable button.
pain_points.impact: Users may miss the alternative CTA.
pain_points.fix: Make it look more like a button or add clear hover/click state.

pain_points.description: Several interactive elements on login/register are below 44px minimum touch target.
pain_points.impact: Mobile users may struggle to tap small buttons/links.
pain_points.fix: Increase all interactive elements to minimum 44x44px on mobile.

pain_points.description: Admin dashboard shows 'Learner View active' banner even though viewing admin content.
pain_points.impact: Banner contradicts what user is actually seeing.
pain_points.fix: Banner should reflect actual view mode or hide entirely on admin pages.

pain_points.description: 540 labs loaded at once in scrollable grid. Extremely long page, overwhelming choice.
pain_points.impact: Slow page load, hard to find specific labs.
pain_points.fix: Add pagination or infinite scroll. Show 20-30 labs per page.

pain_points.description: All courses show 'CORE' badge with no distinction between required and optional.
pain_points.impact: Users may waste time on elective courses.
pain_points.fix: Clearly differentiate core vs elective. Show 'Recommended Path' with priority ordering.
